mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 46 degrees with clear skies near Verona Area High School. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has shared details on two important projects. First, the Military Ridge State Trail is getting a major upgrade with new bridges and fresh pavement, with a public meeting set for December 8th at the Senior Center. Additionally, the city reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles weekly trash and biweekly recycling, and they encourage home composting to help manage food waste.

There is plenty to do in town over the next few days. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.

In a report covering November 1st through November 15th, police noted that on November 8th, a driver was arrested for O W I after crashing into a curb, a tree, and a light pole on South Main Street, which also caused the vehicle to catch fire.

Today at Culver's, the flavor of the day is the fan-favorite Caramel Turtle. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
